description: Implementation of Dio (Digital Input/Output) module for AUTOSAR, managing GPIO lines via gpiod library, including initialization, read/write, flip, port operations, and version info.

methods.name: Dio_Init
methods.description: Initializes the Dio module, setting up GPIO lines based on configuration.

methods.name: Dio_ReadChannel
methods.description: Reads the current level of a specified channel.

methods.name: Dio_WriteChannel
methods.description: Sets the level of a specified channel.

methods.name: Dio_FlipChannel
methods.description: Toggles the level of a specified channel.

methods.name: Dio_ReadPort
methods.description: Reads the levels of all channels in a port.

methods.name: Dio_WritePort
methods.description: Writes levels to all channels in a port.

methods.name: Dio_MaskedWritePort
methods.description: Writes levels to a port with a mask.

methods.name: Dio_ReadChannelGroup
methods.description: Reads a group of channels defined by a mask and offset.

methods.name: Dio_WriteChannelGroup
methods.description: Writes to a group of channels defined by a mask and offset.

methods.name: Dio_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Provides version information of the Dio module.
